name: PublisherOpsAI
author: Muhammad

sections.description:
PublisherOps AI helps publishers, editors, agencies, and multisite content teams automate AI-assisted editorial workflows directly inside WordPress.

Built specifically for publisher operations, the plugin combines AI optimization, editorial humanization, workflow automation, and link governance into a single workflow platform.

Key Features

  • AI-powered content optimization
  • Bulk optimization queue system
  • Background AI processing engine
  • Editorial tone control
  • Humanizer engine for natural content
  • Internal and external link governance
  • Publisher-safe workflow automation
  • Queue progress tracking
  • Live queue auto-refresh
  • Optimization activity logs
  • Modern SaaS-style admin dashboard

External Services

PublisherOpsAI can connect to third-party AI services to perform AI-powered content optimization. These services are only used when a site administrator selects an AI provider, enters their own API key, and runs an optimization workflow.

Google Gemini API

This plugin can connect to the Google Gemini API when Gemini is selected as the AI provider.

Data sent:
* Post title and post content selected for optimization.
* Optimization instructions generated from the plugin settings.
* Selected tone, humanizer, and editorial settings.

Data is sent only when the site administrator manually runs optimization or enables an optimization workflow.

Service provider: Google
Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

OpenAI API

This plugin can connect to the OpenAI API when OpenAI is selected as the AI provider.

Data sent:
* Post title and post content selected for optimization.
* Optimization instructions generated from the plugin settings.
* Selected tone, humanizer, and editorial settings.

Data is sent only when the site administrator manually runs optimization or enables an optimization workflow.

Service provider: OpenAI
Terms of Use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/publisherops-ai directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open PublisherOps AI from the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Enter your AI provider API key in Settings.
  5. Configure optimization tone and humanizer settings.
  6. Start optimizing posts individually or through Bulk Optimize.
sections.faq:
Which AI providers are supported?

PublisherOps AI currently supports Gemini and OpenAI.

Does the plugin require my own API key?

Yes. During the current beta stage, users provide their own AI API key.

Does the plugin modify content automatically?

Only when initiated by the user through the plugin workflow settings.

Can I optimize multiple posts at once?

Yes. The Bulk Optimize queue allows safe background processing of multiple posts.

Is PublisherOps AI suitable for multisite publishers?

Yes. The plugin architecture is designed for publisher workflows, agencies, and content networks.
